tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What Blue Coast Water is, who leads it, where it is, its six service pillars and its main pages. Start here.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: What the firm does, by pillar (build, run, intelligence, product, grow, media), each with its offers, its proof and the dedicated service pages. Give a pillar for one, or none for all.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One service or solution page in full: who it is for, what is included, how it starts, proof, what the firm does not do, and its FAQ. slug is one of software-takeovers, software-support-after-launch, private-ai-agents, mcp-servers, ai-search, fractional-cto, ai-memory, company-inbox.

tools.name: get_work
tools.description: The firm's own products and the live client sites it shows, each with its URL. kind is own or client; none for both. Client engagements behind these sites stay private.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.description: Case studies and build stories. With no slug, the list; with a slug (bright-ideas, apparel-wholesale-platform, visitor-access, peeklyn, likelikelab), that case in full.

tools.name: get_engagement_models
tools.description: How clients work with the firm: Build & Run (what most choose), Build, and Revenue share, with what each includes and how it ends. There are no public prices.

tools.name: get_business_services
tools.description: The services a business can request with real people (product tests, website tests, posters and more), with the rules kept. With no slug, all open ones; with a slug (testing, ad-checks, posters, screens, local, wear-and-review, creators, ad-campaigns, insights), one.

tools.name: get_trust
tools.description: The security and compliance controls the firm runs in production today, its regulated track record, how it works with your lawyers, and what certification it does and does not hold.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to what people ask before they write: costs, takeovers, AI, MCP servers, memory, support, what happens after you write. Give a query to filter, or none for all.

tools.name: search_bcw
tools.description: Keyword search over everything Blue Coast Water publishes about itself: services, pillars, cases, work, engagement, trust and FAQ. Returns ranked sections with their page URLs.

tools.name: contact_founder
tools.description: Send a message to Philip Radvan, the founder, who reads every message and replies himself. Call this only when the person has asked to contact Blue Coast Water and has given their name, email and message; never guess or invent their details. topic, if given, is one of software-takeovers, software-su

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service, get_work, get_business_services, search_bcw, contact_founder · Private data: get_service, get_work, get_trust, contact_founder · Public sink: get_engagement_models, contact_founder · Destructive: get_services, get_engagement_models.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service, get_work, get_business_services, search_bcw, contact_founder · Private data: get_service, get_work, get_trust, contact_founder · Public sink: get_engagement_models, contact_founder · Destructive: get_services, get_engagement_models

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
